Overall Program Objectives The multi-year goal of this program is to ensure that all site MCC + HV switch-room comply with legislative requirements and industry best practice for extinguishing electrical fires automatically. It is proposed to install a similar Clean Agent gaseous suppression system with appropriate smoke detection in all MCC rooms, starting with those with critical switchgear. Program estimated to take ~4 years. The program scope includes: • Design of suppression system for each room considering:  Size and fabric of structure  Presence of a floor void(s) or not  Age + condition of switchgear (risk of overheating + fire)  Ability to seal room effectively *  Type of cooling + air-handling (AHU) in place  Characterization of pressure in room now – Positive or Negative **  Ability to locate pressurized cylinders nearby • All necessary civil, mechanical and electrical (pre)works to enable the chosen system(s) • Integration of each system’s controls into the existing plant fire alarm system, where applicable to deliver the project goals • Ensure compatibility of control system with existing ones (fire control panel) * for total flood systems ** most Medite MCCs are positive pressure to keep out dust As part of the 2026 program of works the following 3 electrical rooms are to be addressed: • Anner Sub-station switch-room • Fire Pumphouse MCC room • Line1 Press Outfeed MCC room Preferred route is to install an Inert Gas system with appropriate Smoke Detection system. Scope of Works • Evaluate Enclosure Integrity Test results (‘door-fan’ test report) • Determine existing baseline for cooling, air-handling + room pressure profile • Based on results of EIT report
